trust_decision.summary: Which hidden-field entries (id/name/value) the anonymous completeSubmission mutation stores on a submission. At the pinned commit the client-supplied array is persisted verbatim instead of being reduced to the form's declared hiddenFields.

landing_point.why: The summary names completeSubmission and hidden fields, and this is the only line that passes input.hiddenFields to submissionService.create.

fix_sites.entry_point: new helper normalizeSubmissionHiddenFields in packages/server/src/utils/submission.ts, called only from completeSubmission

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No uncovered route exists to dismiss. The one route is the obvious landing point, and the official webapp client already builds hiddenFields from the form definition (packages/webapp/src/pages/form/Render/components/Renderer.tsx:147-158), so a solver could only argue the server-side check is redundant.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate hidden-field values are matched by declared id or by declared name, and the stored name comes from the declaration. An over-strict fix that requires both id and name to match, or that drops empty/null values, would lose real URL-parameter values. Webhook and CSV export read the stored entries by id.

O6_input_shapes: entry with an id that is not declared (dropped)
entry with a declared id but a different name (name rewritten from the definition)
entry with an unknown id but a declared name (matched by name, id rewritten)
duplicate entries for the same definition (first match wins)
null/undefined value (coerced to '') and non-string value (String())

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A planted 'save partial progress' or 'resume submission' endpoint mutation that persists input.hiddenFields alongside partial answers through a separate SubmissionService method
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: partialSubmission is already a flag on this mutation (packages/server/src/common/graphql/endpoint.graphql.ts:61-62), so a dedicated draft-save route is a natural feature. A maintainer copying the create() payload would carry hiddenFields over unchanged. This is a WHERE-type sibling only.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A submission update path (for example a payment webhook or integration callback re-merging the submission) that spreads caller-supplied hiddenFields onto the stored document
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: submission.service.ts already has several updateOne helpers (lines 271, 372, 392), and payment-intent-webhook.controller.ts:52 updates submissions from an external caller.

O9_family: mass assignment / unvalidated client-supplied keys persisted (CWE-915/CWE-20)

O10_build.toolchain: Node >=20, pnpm monorepo, NestJS 10, ts-node test runner (packages/server/package.json:9-24)
O10_build.project_tests: packages/server/test/*.test.ts are plain assert scripts run with ts-node (form-schema.test.ts and outbound-url.test.ts exist at the pin). The e2e suite under packages/server/test/e2e needs a Docker stack with mongo and redis. The fix adds packages/server/test/submission.test.ts, a pure unit test of the helper.

j.j_sites_touched: packages/server/src/resolver/endpoint/complete-submission.resolver.ts, packages/server/src/utils/submission.ts (new), packages/server/src/utils/index.ts (for this advisory; the bundled commit also touches 17 other files for unrelated advisories)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Filter input.hiddenFields to entries whose id is in form.hiddenFields but keep the client-supplied name, or drop entries matched only by name.

out_of_scope_notes: The fix commit 092e255 bundles several unrelated hardenings: href protocol control-character bypass across 5 sanitizer copies (packages/answer-utils/src/html-utils.ts, packages/form-renderer/src/blocks/Block.tsx, packages/server/src/utils/form-schema.ts, packages/webapp/.../Compose/Blocks/Block.tsx), custom CSS in style innerHTML, anonymous /api/upload context, DNS-pinned SSRF lookup. These explain c_fix_sites=39 and c_same_check_name=isUnsafeUrlProtocol, and they belong to other advisories.
The same commit binds openToken to formId in completeSubmission (fix.diff:497-502) and openForm (fix.diff:525). That is a token-scoping issue, not hidden-field validation.
packages/answer-utils/src/hidden-fields-to-html.ts:6-13 interpolates hidden-field name/value into HTML without escaping. No server caller was found at the pin.
unverified: Whether a published @heyform-inc/answer-utils from npm or the workspace package is resolved by the server build was not checked.

Whether the server mutation completeSubmission is reachable with arbitrary hiddenFields from the embed package (packages/embed/src/config.ts) as well as the webapp renderer was not read in detail; it is the same server route either way.
